source_title: Patrick Stewart Had ‘Non-Existent’ Relationship with His 2 Kids Before Death - People.com
source_excerpt:
The actor shares his son Daniel and his daughter Sophie with ex-wife Sheila Falconer
Patrick Stewart previously shared his grief over not being closer with his two kids before his death at age 86
The actor said his relationships with his kids Daniel and Sophie were practically “non-existent” in a 2023 interview
The actor blamed prioritizing his career over family and said he could have been a better parent
In the years before his death at age 86, Patrick Stewart voiced his grief over not being closer with his two kids.
During his 2023 interview with Irish Independent , the late Star Trek: The Next Generation star shared that he had “significant grief” over his separation from his two kids — Daniel, 59, and Sophie, 54 — whom he shares with ex-wife Sheila Falconer.
“Given that I’m separated from my children now — we don’t have relationships — they have become very important,” he told the outlet at the time. “I never thought this would happen, but both my children are in their 50s — they’re not children anymore, they’re adults. And my relationship with them is practically non-existent.”

The actor shared that “not a day goes by” that he isn’t “pained by the memory of my children, who they were and by a sense of responsibility that they became who they are in part because of me and my influence or lack of influence on them.”
Asked why he had a strained relationship with his kids, he said, “I always put my acting work first, before my family.”
“I could’ve done better as a parent, when my kids were little. I was just obsessed with my work and everything else took second place,” continued Stewart. “I’m trying to correct that now whenever possible with my grandchildren. And my own children seem to have forgiven me.”
Stewart and his ex-wife Falconer split in 1990. The actor went on to marry again twice, first to Wendy Neuss from 2000 to 2003, and then to Sunny Ozell , whom he wed in 2013.
On Thursday, Oct. 29, Kelly Bush Novak, longtime spokesperson for Stewart, said in a statement to PEOPLE, “We announce with great sorrow the passing of Sir Patrick Stewart yesterday at his home in Los Angeles, in the loving care of his beloved wife Sunny, following a brief and poignant journey with Alzheimer’s Disease and Lewy Body Dementia.”
“He has been held in the warm embrace of family and friends, surrounded by live music, prayer, tears, laughter, and the kind of profound emotion that only he could inspire after a lifetime of devotion to us all. We will forever cherish the peaceful ease and reflection on his face, an enduring reminder of his invincible grace.”
Stewart previously spoke with PEOPLE about his relationship with his kids in 2022. At the time, the iconic actor shared that becoming a dad was a “marvelous” thing .
“Cherish every moment when your children are young. I loved Daniel when he was little, and when he was a baby, I loved holding him,” he shared. “It was fantastic. When my daughter was born, I was very much a caretaker because her mother was a wonderful dancer and appeared in musicals.”
“I took over the job of being mom and dad, and I loved it,” said Stewart. “It was marvelous.”
Stewart’s son Daniel followed in his dad’s footsteps and also became an actor. Daniel, who married actress Mary Stillwaggon Stewart and went on to welcome two kids together, has appeared on both TV and in plays on and off Broadway, as well as on London’s West End.
Though he’s since moved back to England, Daniel told Grit that he had “spent half my life in the States” and had “sort of adopted both countries’ attitudes toward acting.”
“This industry and the fact that we’re both in it brings up all kinds of bizarre circumstances,” Daniel told USA Today . “The lives we lead can be sort of ridiculous. My upbringing wasn’t a typical one in that my mum and dad came home at 5 and dinner was on the table at 6.”
The actor’s daughter Sophie tends to keep her life more private. She has two kids, a son and a daughter.
